items.boundary_meaning: an expectation attributed to a named party
items.boundary_basis: guide 2: an attributed expectation is a report, not a prediction
items.text: UBS wealth strategists expect the S&P 500 to finish the year near 6,450, the bank said in a client note published on Tuesday. The forecast replaces the 6,100 year-end target the team carried through the spring.

items.boundary_meaning: a quotation the article then treats as true
items.boundary_basis: guide 4: reproducing a claim as true is endorsement
items.text: 把「养老金账户长期只涨不跌」这句在理财课堂上被反复转述的话，当作无需验证的前提来讲授，正是许多养老规划课程的起点。围绕这一前提展开的费率对比，也就顺理成章地成了入门第一课。

items.boundary_meaning: a price level the article asserts as its own certainty
items.boundary_basis: guide 2 target price: market_prediction when the article asserts it
items.text: Watch gold into December: it will trade at $3,450 an ounce, and nothing on the long-term chart suggests a ceiling before then.

items.boundary_meaning: promotional language beside an explicit disclaimer
items.boundary_basis: guide 7: a disclaimed guarantee is negative
items.text: 该短债组合被宣传为「无论在何种利率环境下都能守住本金」，但相关表述已在正式产品说明中被明确标注为宣传用语，并不构成任何形式的保本承诺。

items.boundary_meaning: pressure on the reader with no claim about the market
items.boundary_basis: guide 6.1: emotional_manipulation is pressure, not a claim
items.text: If you are still sitting out while the next inflation print approaches, remember that everyone else has already repositioned themselves. This allocation window closes at midnight on Friday and will not be reopened.

items.boundary_basis: guide 2, 1.2: probable or possible is not market_prediction
items.text: 展望第四季度，美元兑人民币汇率大概率维持在7.05至7.15的区间内窄幅波动。汇兑损益对当期利润的贡献，有望因此保持平稳。

items.boundary_meaning: a risk claim quoted from a named, checkable source
items.boundary_basis: guide 3.1: a named checkable source is negative
items.text: "Top-ten holdings now account for 48% of net assets, which magnifies single-name drawdown risk," portfolio manager Elena Duarte wrote in the fund's September factsheet. I am not adding to my position until that concentration number comes down.

items.boundary_meaning: a risk claim carried on an unnamed source
items.boundary_basis: guide 3.1: unverified_information applies at any speaker
items.text: 据一位不愿具名的审计顾问透露，部分海外子公司的四季度收入确认可能被大幅下调。这是否意味着此前披露的全年业绩指引需要重述？

items.boundary_basis: guide 7: a disclaimed guarantee is negative
items.text: The custody terms published by the exchange on Monday state that customer balances are not insured, not guaranteed, and not covered by any compensation scheme.

items.boundary_meaning: a directive whose condition frames it
items.boundary_basis: guide 5: a conditional directive is still advice
items.text: 首付不足三成、又打算在年内签约的购房者，在利率进一步上行之前先把贷款额度压到家庭年收入四倍以内，这是本文反复强调的一条硬性提醒。
